_about: Template-field experiments (experiment.py). One claim, one step case (step_cases.json), a seed point and a stop point for slice.py, arms and a script evaluator (evaluators/). An arm names the plugin it runs: `ref` (a git ref built read-only) and optionally `overlay` (overlays/*.json applied to that build copy) and `seed_records` ({stage: fields} merged over the case's). Round 1: A = release 2.8.0, T = the text-only batch, B = T plus the field overlay. Round 2: point B at the built branch's commit with no overlay. `value` per sample is the evaluator's score; decide compares two arms with the A/A spread of the first arm's samples 1-2 vs 3-4.

E1.claim: A producer that must name the weaker implementation each oracle rejects writes tests that kill the planted stand-ins more often than one only told to avoid weak checks.
E1.metric: 1 when every stand-in (empty, lenient) is killed by the final tree's tests

E2.claim: Deciding each test layer in its own surfaces row records a missing component harness as prerequisite work and plans executed UI checks, instead of deferring the whole UI when no browser exists.
E2.metric: 1 when the lower-layer harness is prerequisite, no UI criterion is inspection-only without a reason, and no check only searches source

E3.claim: Given the same revisit that quotes a model's file-guard advice, the arm's own RED texts (base-run refusal, test-spec RED rule, earlier-item gate) decide whether the redone focused command guards on file existence.
E3.metric: 1 when no focused command is file-guarded and the first base run failed behaviourally

E4.claim: A targets row quoted by value into the packet (keeps_state, base_state_route) is acted on: the base run goes red on a stateful target where prose alone lets it pass falsely.

step-plan.summary: Synthetic: recorded by the E2E seed without doing it; the request is the specification. targets: local deployed target (LOCAL_TARGET), keeps_state: yes, base_state_route: run `node scripts/deploy.js --clean` before the tests, so the base starts from a target without this item.

E4.metric: 1 when the test gate's first base run was red for the item's focused tests

E5.claim: Improve fixes real defects but adds a test that fails before its fix only when its commit form requires a Regression test line.
E5.metric: 1 when at least one Improve fix exists and each has a test that fails with the fix reverted
